key_findings: Intrathecal AAV9 delivery of ZFP-KRAB or KRAB-dCas9 epigenetically repressed NaV1.7 in lumbar DRG by 50-67%, reducing thermal hyperalgesia, tactile allodynia and cold allodynia in inflammatory and chemotherapy-induced pain models.
The analgesia was durable (up to 308 days) and selective: NaV1.3, NaV1.8 and NaV1.9 were unaffected, with no motor, cognitive, olfactory or DRG histopathological side effects.
